headline: Google expands AI infrastructure hiring as enterprise cloud deals accelerate
body: Google DeepMind is aggressively recruiting AI engineers with compensation packages reaching $1.1 million and no degree requirement, while simultaneously deepening enterprise partnerships like CaixaBank's expanded Google Cloud deal focused on AI deployment. For healthcare AI practitioners, this signals Google's commitment to scaling AI talent and infrastructure at a time when healthcare organizations are evaluating cloud partners for clinical AI initiatives. The talent surge combined with enterprise wins suggests Google is positioning itself as a serious contender for healthcare's AI infrastructure needs, particularly for organizations seeking GPU-accelerated compute and managed AI services. Healthcare AI consultants should monitor these hiring patterns and partnership announcements as indicators of vendor capability and commitment to healthcare-specific AI applications.
